title: Merging a branch now requires Production Branches read-write
summary: Merging a branch now requires Production Branches read-write
body_markdown:
## What changed


Since November 12, 2026, merging a branch into your main project needs a scoped personal access token with **Production Branches: Read-write** . A token that only has **Development Branches: Read-write** gets a permission error when it calls[Merge a branch](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/v1-merge-a-branch) or the MCP` merge_branch` tool.


Creating, pushing, resetting, and deleting preview branches with a development-only token works as before.


## Why we made this change


A merge applies a branch's changes to your production project. Before this change, a token meant only for development branches could still write to production through a merge. Requiring production access closes that gap. A token you give to CI or an AI agent for preview work can no longer write to production.


## Who is affected


You're affected if you merge branches with a scoped personal access token that has Development Branches read-write but not Production Branches read-write. Classic personal access tokens are not affected.


## What happens if you take no action


Merges made with a development-only token fail with a permission error. Your projects, branches, and data stay the same.


## Migration steps


1. Create a new token in[Account > Access Tokens](https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens) with Production Branches read-write. You can't change the permissions of an existing token.
2. Use the new token for the merge step in your CI or scripts.
3. Keep your development-only token for everything else, such as creating and resetting preview branches.


## Rollout timeline


Date Milestone User action


2026-11-12 Merge requires Production Branches read-write Use a token with Production Branches read-write


We plan to add a separate Merge permission later, so a token can merge without full production write access.
